text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...――

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: (Oh no... no, no, no! What is this?!)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(Even though I just ran at full power!! I 
want to run at full power even more than 
before!!)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Oooooohh!!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—Splendid. That was a truly direct and 
powerful run, just like you, Bamboo-san.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...Seeing your fiery passion, I must 
follow suit...!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Trainer-saaaan!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Bamboo Memory!! I'm baaack!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: THANK YOU SO MUUUCH!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I'm just... so fired up I can't 
stand it!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
So let us return to the academy at once!! 
And then, let us train!! Immediately!!

Bamboo Memory is brimming with even more 
vitality than before heading into the 
race. I'd better make the most of this 
motivation...!
choice_data_list:
When we get back, it's time for a 
debrief-slash-training session!

When we get back, we'll have a debrief and 
training session!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ...! Yes, sir!! Thank you so much!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
All right!! DAAAAAASHING back to the 
academy!! Let's go!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Aaah! That's right!!

And so, Bamboo Memory's debut race 
concluded, leaving her fighting spirit 
burning hotter than ever...!
—And the day after her debut race...

During a meeting with Bamboo Memory to 
confirm our future plansâ

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
So, what kind of plan are you thinking for 
the Junior class, Trainer?
choice_data_list:
First, let's gain experience without 
rushing.

text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory has wonderful potential. 
However, it's also true that much remains 
unknown about which races will allow her 
to shine brightest.

So during the Junior Year, we'll hone her 
acceleration—her greatest weapon—without 
rushing for results, and search for the 
stage where she can truly become the 
strongest through actual races.
In a sense, this isâ

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: A w-a-r-r-i-o-r-'s p-i-l-g-r-i-m-a-g-e...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Super!! Freakin'!! Hot, isn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Let's go on a training journey! Right now! 
What should we do!? Should we just start 
running for now!?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ha— That was a close one... I almost went 
all the way back out onto the track again.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I get the general plan now! A 
training journey... I’m getting fired 
up!!”

The days of passionate training and honing 
skills in the Junior Class were about to 
begin...!
